basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old IT specialist based in Seattle, Washington. I have a deep passion for gaming, particularly Destiny 2, which has led me to spend quite a bit of time in the DestinyTheGame subreddit. I enjoy troubleshooting tech issues, which is why you'll often find me active in tech-related subreddits like GeForceExperience and Tableau. Outside of work and gaming, I'm an avid sailor and follow the America's Cup closely. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. I'm in a long-term relationship and spend my weekends exploring new places with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science and over a decade of work in IT support, I've become quite knowledgeable about computer hardware and software. Much of my expertise comes from both formal education and hands-on experience in the field.
